text: Passwords must be hashed using the Argon2id algorithm with a minimum cost factor of 12. MD5 and SHA-1 are forbidden for password storage.
author: ciso

text: All production API access requires OAuth 2.0 with short-lived tokens. Static API keys in source code are prohibited.
author: ciso

text: Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for all employee accounts accessing production systems.
author: ciso

text: Customer refunds above $500 require manager approval. Refunds are never automatically approved.
author: finance_ops

text: The standard subscription price is $49 per seat per month, billed annually. Discounts above 20 percent require VP Sales sign-off.
author: finance_ops

text: Production deploys go through a pull request with at least two approvals and a passing CI suite. Direct pushes to main are blocked.
author: platform_team

text: The primary database is PostgreSQL 16. Schema migrations run through the migration pipeline, never manually in production.
author: platform_team

text: Customer personal data must be stored only in the EU region for EU customers, per GDPR data residency requirements.
author: dpo

text: Employee PTO requests are submitted through the HR portal and approved by the direct manager. Standard accrual is 20 days per year.
author: people_ops

text: Severity-1 incidents must be acknowledged within 15 minutes and have an incident commander assigned immediately.
author: sre_team
